identity.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SYSUTCDATETIME() AS observed_at, CAST(DATABASEPROPERTYEX(DB_NAME(),'Updateability') AS nvarchar(128)) AS updateability

resource_labels_base.sql:
SELECT r.RESOURCE_LANGUAGE,r.RESOURCE_GROUP,r.RESOURCE_KEY,r.TEXT,r.FIELD_LENGTH,r.DECIMAL_POS FROM dbo.RESOURCE_FILE_BASE r JOIN (SELECT FORM_KEY_NAME AS RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.FORM
UNION SELECT MENU_RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.MAIN_UI_SCREEN
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_PART
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_GROUP
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_CONTROL
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS
UNION SELECT ACTION_RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.DYNAMIC_ACTION) k ON k.RESOURCE_KEY=r.RESOURCE_KEY WHERE r.RESOURCE_LANGUAGE='en-US' ORDER BY r.RESOURCE_GROUP,r.RESOURCE_KEY

resource_labels_custom.sql:
SELECT r.RESOURCE_LANGUAGE,r.RESOURCE_GROUP,r.RESOURCE_KEY,r.TEXT,r.FIELD_LENGTH,r.DECIMAL_POS FROM dbo.RESOURCE_FILE_CUSTOM r JOIN (SELECT FORM_KEY_NAME AS RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.FORM
UNION SELECT MENU_RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.MAIN_UI_SCREEN
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_PART
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_GROUP
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_CONTROL
UNION SELECT RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS
UNION SELECT ACTION_RESOURCE_KEY FROM dbo.DYNAMIC_ACTION) k ON k.RESOURCE_KEY=r.RESOURCE_KEY WHERE r.RESOURCE_LANGUAGE='en-US' ORDER BY r.RESOURCE_GROUP,r.RESOURCE_KEY
